about: A 30-person company that sells Leafdesk, a help-desk app for small shops, on monthly plans.

T-318.subject: How do I add two more agents?

T-322.subject: Want a refund, the email import never worked

policies.refunds: Full refund within 30 days of the first payment; after that, pro-rated credit only. Refunds above $500 need the support lead's approval.
policies.seats: Seats can be added any time from Settings > Team; billing is pro-rated to the next renewal.
policies.failed_payment: We retry a failed card 3 times over 7 days, then the account goes read-only. Never ask a customer for a card number in a ticket.

L-84.interest: Business plan for 6 sites, SSO required

prices.notes: USD per seat per month. Annual billing = 2 months free. Business includes SSO and audit log.
